name: Oujo Kafar no [Bad End] Happy End
original_name: 王女カファールの[バッドエンド]ハッピーエンド
source:
Princess Kafal, whose kingdom was suddenly destroyed, fled with her royal guards.
However, when she awoke, she found herself captured by a band of lustful male bandits.
A text-only, simplified visual novel featuring 13 erotic scenes depicting the princess being violated by the bandits.
translation:
卡法尔公主的王国突然毁灭，她与皇家卫兵一起逃亡。
然而醒来后，她发现自己被一群好色的男性盗贼俘虏。
一部纯文字简化视觉小说，收录13个公主遭盗贼侵犯的色情场景。
